briefdescription.para: The Xvm instance within which this Container exists.
The Container within which this Container was created.

detaileddescription.para: The parent Container can only be null iff this is the native Container (id == -1).

briefdescription.para: The Ecstasy TypeSystem used by this Container.
The Injector that provides the values for dependency injection into this Container.
The internal numeric identity of the Container, with -1 being the "native" container, 0 being the "main" container, and >0 being child containers.

memberdef.argsstring: (Container parent, long id, TypeSystem typeSystem, Injector injector)
memberdef.name: Container

parameterdescription.para: the parent Container that is creating this Container
the internal id of this Container; -1 is the native container, 0 is the main container, and all other values (where n>0) indicate child containers created by Ecstasy code

simplesect.para: true iff the Container is the "core" (or "native") container, which is responsible for loading the core Ecstasy type system and interfacing with the "native" world
true iff the Container is a "main" container (often referred to as "container zero", although this implementation allows for more than one main container)
true iff the Container is a nested Container, which means that it is neither a "main" Container nor the "core" Container

briefdescription.para: Determine if the specified name is defined in this context.

simplesect.para: true iff the name is defined

briefdescription.para: Determine if the XVM Structure specified by the passed constant is present in this context.

parameterdescription.para: a ModuleConstant, PackageConstant, ClassConstant, PropertyConstant, or MethodConstant.

simplesect.para: true iff the specified structure is present in this context

briefdescription.para: Determine if the module specified by the passed constant is present in this context and of the specified version, or a version substitutable therefor.

simplesect.para: true iff the specified module is present in this context and of the specified version

briefdescription.para: Tests if the version of "this" module matches the specified version.

parameterdescription.para: the version of this module to test for

simplesect.para: true iff the module being loaded within this context has the specified version
